title: Hero images of the outer-scale and black-hole panels (B3, UXD-023)
description: Maps '<level>/<id>' to the picture its panel shows as the hero. A photoKey names a deep-sky gallery image (served as its thumb, credited from deep-sky.json and the provenance row of the full file); a src is a served image with its own provenance row. pictured marks a photo of a part of the entity (30 Doradus for the LMC): the panel then captions what is pictured. validate-data checks every key resolves to a file and a provenance row.
